scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @artifact-editor/server" "npm run dev --workspace @artifact-editor/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace @artifact-editor/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace @artifact-editor/server
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @artifact-editor/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @artifact-editor/sdk && npm run test --workspace @artifact-editor/server && npm run test --workspace @artifact-editor/web
scripts.test:checkpoints: npm run build:sdk && npm run test --workspace @artifact-editor/server
scripts.test:editor: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:editor --workspace @artifact-editor/web
scripts.test:inspector: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:inspector --workspace @artifact-editor/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace @artifact-editor/web
scripts.start: npm run build:sdk && npm run start --workspace @artifact-editor/server
